rows.value: Profit under actual revenue and expenses is taxed on the progressive scale (16% to 50%); or the simplified normiranec regime below
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Simplified regime (normiranec, flat-rate expenses)
rows.value: Expenses deemed at 80% of revenue up to €60,000; nothing on revenue above €60,000 for the full-time self-employed (at most €48,000); tax 20% of the base up to €72,000, 35% above
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad residence permit
rows.value: Yes, since 21 November 2025: non-EU/EEA nationals working remotely for employers or clients outside Slovenia, or self-employed abroad; up to 12 months, not extendable (reapply 6 months after expiry)
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministry of the Interior): Temporary residence permit for digital nomads (21. 11. 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad permit: income requirement
rows.value: Monthly means of at least 2× the average monthly net wage in Slovenia (from the latest average gross wage in the Official Gazette)
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministry of the Interior): Temporary residence permit for digital nomads (21. 11. 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad permit: tax consequence
rows.value: No special regime: the ordinary income tax rules apply; a nomad who becomes resident (permanent residence, centre of interests or more than 183 days in the year) is taxed on worldwide income
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.
rows.source_title: FURS: Obdavčitev tujcev z dovoljenjem za začasno prebivanje za digitalnega nomada po ZDoh-2 in mednarodnih pogodbah, podrobnejši opis (1. izdaja, januar 2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: residents are taxed on worldwide income on the normal scale and allowances; FURS guidance for new residents applies the ordinary ZDoh-2 rules
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates, the side-activity flat amounts and the normiranec details follow.
rows.source_title: FURS: Obdavčitev tujcev z dovoljenjem za začasno prebivanje za digitalnega nomada po ZDoh-2 in mednarodnih pogodbah, podrobnejši opis (1. izdaja, januar 2026)

rows.basis: Revenue under the accounting rules; tax on revenue minus deemed expenses (no other deductions)
rows.note: Exit: a normiranec whose average revenue over the two previous years exceeds the same limits must switch to actual expenses. Revenue of related persons counts towards the limits (ZPZR-A).
